notices.title: Stratford (London) Rail Station
notices.detail: MILDMAY LINE: Monday 26, Tuesday 27, Wednesday 28 and Thursday 29 October, the 2147 Clapham Junction to Stratford train will not run. The 2203 and 2234 Clapham Junction to Stratford trains terminate at Willesden Junction. The 2249 train from Richmond to Stratford will terminate at Willesden Junction at 2306

notices.title: Stratford (London) Rail Station
notices.detail: MILDMAY LINE: Monday 26, Tuesday 27, Wednesday 28 and Thursday 29 October, from 2345 each evening, no westbound service from Stratford to Camden Road. The 2359 and 0015 services from Stratford will start from Camden Road at 0018 and 0035. Customers should use the last westbound service from Stratford at 2344, or local bus routes 30, 274, 388, 393 or 488.
